items.title: The multiplicity of two-periodic complexes is additive in short exact sequences
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology), section on periodic complexes and multiplicities
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that e_R is additive in short exact sequences of 2-periodic complexes, with the additional statement that finite length of two out of three cohomology modules forces it for the third (statement lines 210-224). The work is to package the long exact cohomology sequence of the given short exact sequence into the finite exact sequence 0 -> I -> H^0(A) -> H^0(B) -> H^0(C) -> H^1(A) -> H^1(B) -> K -> 0 together with the filtration 0 -> K -> H^1(C) -> I -> 0, so that the alternating sum of lengths becomes exactly the difference of the two e_R terms (proof lines 230-251). Once that bookkeeping is done the numerical conclusion is a single citation of additivity of length, so the claim is H2.
